units.source_text: （祖父之所以想去东京见大隈重信，是因为有自己的目的。

en.t: My grandfather wanted to go to Tokyo to meet Okuma Shigenobu because he had a purpose of his own.

units.source_text: 祖父多少有点汉医素养，我父亲又是东京医科学校毕业的医生，所以祖父也懂点父亲会的西医医术，然后把它融会到自己的汉医学中去，长期给村里人行医施药。

en.t: My grandfather had some grounding in Chinese medicine, and since my father was a doctor who had graduated from Tokyo Medical School, my grandfather also knew a little of the Western medicine my father practiced; he blended it into his own Chinese medical practice and for many years treated the villagers and gave them medicine.

units.source_text: 而且，祖父对自己一派的医术非常自信。

en.t: Moreover, my grandfather had great confidence in the medical methods of his own school.

units.source_text: 促使祖父更加自信的，是在村里流行痢疾的时候。

en.t: What made him still more confident was the time when dysentery spread through the village.

units.source_text: 也就是上面写过的那年夏天，由于改建尼姑庵，把佛像暂时放置在我家客厅里。

en.t: It was the summer I mentioned above, when the nunnery was being rebuilt and the Buddhist images were temporarily placed in the sitting room of our house.

units.source_text: 仅有五十户人家的村子，却有许多人患了痢疾，几乎是平均每户一人，闹到新建了两处临时隔离医院。

en.t: Although the village had only fifty households, many people came down with dysentery, almost one person per household on average, and the outbreak grew so serious that two temporary isolation hospitals were built.

units.source_text: 连野外都飘荡着消毒剂的臭味。

en.t: Even outdoors, the stench of disinfectant hung in the air.

units.source_text: 村里人都说，这是惊动了尼姑庵的佛爷的报应。

en.t: Everyone in the village said it was divine punishment for disturbing the Buddha of the nunnery.

units.source_text: 可是，有的人服用了我祖父的药，很快把痢疾治愈了。

en.t: But some people took my grandfather's medicine and were soon cured of dysentery.

units.source_text: 也有的人家把病人隐藏起来，悄悄地让他喝祖父的药而得救了。

en.t: There were also families who hid their sick and secretly gave them my grandfather's medicine to drink, and they were saved.

units.source_text: 一些住在隔离医院的患者，把医院的药扔掉，服用祖父的药。

en.t: Some patients in the isolation hospitals threw away the hospital medicine and took my grandfather's instead.

units.source_text: 有的病人，医院已经不给他们治疗了，可服用了祖父的药却得救了。

en.t: Some patients whom the hospitals had already stopped treating were nevertheless saved after taking my grandfather's medicine.

units.source_text: 祖父的医术在医学上究竟有多大的价值不得而知，但祖父的药取得了想象不到的疗效，这是事实。

en.t: It is impossible to know how much medical value my grandfather's methods truly had, but it is a fact that his medicine produced effects no one had imagined.

units.source_text: 因此，祖父就想把这种药推广到社会上去。

en.t: For that reason, my grandfather wanted to bring this medicine out into wider society.

units.source_text: 之后，他曾让自乐师傅代写了申请书，并得到内务省准许出卖三四种药。

en.t: Afterward, he had Master Jiraku write an application for him and obtained permission from the Home Ministry to sell three or four kinds of medicine.

units.source_text: 但是，带有东村山龙堂字号的包装纸，也不过印了五六千张，制药的事不久也中断了。

en.t: But only five or six thousand sheets of wrapping paper bearing the trade name Higashimurayama Ryudo were printed, and before long the medicine-making enterprise came to a halt as well.

units.source_text: 这些药方，直到逝世都留在祖父的脑子里。

en.t: Those prescriptions remained in my grandfather's head until the day he died.

units.source_text: 于是祖父抱着孩子般的信念，确信去东京见到尊敬的人物大隈重信，定会取得他的帮助。

en.t: And so, with a childlike faith, my grandfather was convinced that if he went to Tokyo and met the man he revered, Okuma Shigenobu, he would surely receive his help.

units.source_text: 除了药之外，祖父大概还想出版《构宅安危论》等。）

en.t: Apart from the medicine, my grandfather probably also wanted to publish works such as On the Safety and Peril of House Construction.
